comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
There is a guide now (thanks Beomi) but in essence, enter the dungeon and continue advancing floor by floor until the exit marker triggers a screen flash and has this message: "You have found the special passage! It seems that it leads to a room which has an air of magnificence."

Fighting enemies and opening chests is not required, just going deeper into the dungeon until you get that message. This is true of all dungeon TH quests. Cheers, and in case it helps, here's the guide I got my info from:

uwo-atlantis.blogspot.com/
